recipes.title: Weeknight Tomato Pasta
recipes.instructions:
Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
While it cooks, warm the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat and soften the garlic for about a minute, until fragrant but not coloured.
Add the tomatoes, crushing them with the back of a spoon, and simmer for ten minutes until thickened.
Drain the pasta, reserving a cup of the cooking water, and toss it through the sauce with a splash of that water to bring it together.
Tear over the basil, season, and serve with grated parmesan.
